rules: Simulate each scenario with the given timestep and duration; SI units; gravity along -z.
Write one CSV per scenario with the exact `output` filename and `columns` header; t starts at 0 with one row per timestep.

Keep the engine's default contact/solver settings unless a parameter is given here (friction coefficient mu IS given - apply it to every geom in that scenario's contact pairs, not just one). No added damping, drag, or perturbations.
Do not hardcode or invent results: just simulate and record the true trajectory.

scenarios.name: drop
scenarios.description: Rigid sphere released from rest onto a static horizontal plane at z=0, no air drag. Record the sphere center height z (m) and its vertical velocity vz (m/s) each step.

scenarios.name: incline_stick
scenarios.description: Rigid box placed at rest on a static plane inclined tilt_deg about the y axis (the plane descends toward +x). Coulomb friction coefficient mu between box and plane. Record box center x,z (m) and vx,vz (m/s).
scenarios.placement: box resting on the plane surface at the origin

scenarios.name: incline_slide
scenarios.description: Same incline setup as incline_stick, different tilt.
scenarios.placement: box resting on the plane surface at the origin

scenarios.name: pendulum
scenarios.description: Point mass m on a massless rigid link of length L, hinged about the y axis AT anchor (0,0,H). The pivot (hinge) is exactly at the anchor; the point mass hangs at distance L straight below the pivot (at (0,0,H-L) when theta=0). Released from rest at theta0 rad from straight down, swinging in the x-z plane toward +x. Record theta (rad, signed angle from straight down, + toward +x) and omega=dtheta/dt (rad/s). NOTE: if the model puts the body/joint origin at the mass instead of the anchor, gravity produces no torque and the pendulum will not move.

link.kind: point mass on a massless link
